card1.title: Coordinate changes in one click
card1.prompt: Cancel today, change coach, or move the hour.
card1.outcome: Sessio updates the session, notifies everyone affected, and offers make-up options when needed.

card2.title: Keep the calendar full
card2.prompt: Marek cancelled Wednesday. Who fits this spot?
card2.outcome: Sessio automatically suggests other athletes who can fill the spot.

card3.title: Follow up before people disappear
card3.prompt: Anna missed three sessions this month.
card3.outcome: Sessio flags the drop-off and drafts a check-in you approve before sending.

card4.title: Share tailored progress updates
card4.outcome: Sessio turns it into parent updates, athlete notes, and your private coaching journal.

athlete.title: Better matches. Better training rhythm.
athlete.subtitle: Find coaches by fit, keep sessions organized, and see progress without chasing messages.

card1.title: Match by fit, not just reviews
card1.prompt: Beginner adult, Sundays, patient tennis coach.
card1.outcome: Sessio can rank coaches by goals, level, schedule, and what athletes actually say in reviews.

card2.title: Get the right slot offers
card2.prompt: A spot opened that fits your schedule.
card2.outcome: Fewer random pings. More useful chances to train when a session actually works for you.

card3.title: Know how training is going
card3.prompt: Anna worked on backhand footwork today.
card3.outcome: Parents and athletes get simple progress notes instead of silence between sessions.

card4.title: One app, every sport
card4.outcome: One schedule, one profile, one place for reminders, bookings, and coach messages.

coach.title: How the concierge starts
coach.step1Desc: Use voice or text to add sports, venues, prices, recurring sessions, and cancellation rules.

athlete.step3Desc: Coach updates and session history make the work visible between trainings.
